source: TSTD, comprehensive mung bean cultivation manual, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Mung bean], 2013
text: Pest coverage includes pod borer (larvae boring into pods and feeding on developing seed), leaf miner (larvae tunneling within leaf tissue, visible as winding pale trails), aphid (sap-feeding colonies on shoots/pods, also a virus vector), and stink bug (pod-feeding, causing shrivelled/discolored seed) — each with identification notes and control recommendations following the same cultural-plus-targeted-chemical approach used across this batch's other pulse-crop pest sections.
